question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Access**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Access **means the ability or right to approach, use, or obtain something. (किसी चीज़ तक पहुँचने, उपयोग करने या प्राप्त करने की क्षमता या अधिकार)

 
 
• **Example**: With the new digital platform, students have easy access to a vast array of educational resources.
 
 
 
• The use of the word "access" implies not only the availability of sustainable energy but also the affordability and reliability of that energy.
 
• So, "**access**" is the appropriate word to convey the idea that sustainable development is achievable by ensuring that residents have the opportunity to use affordable, reliable, and sustainable energy sources.

Thus, **option 4 **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Excess**: An amount or quantity beyond what is necessary, usual, or specified. (आवश्यक, सामान्य या निर्दिष्ट से अधिक मात्रा या मात्रा)
 
• **Power**: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others. (कुछ करने या किसी विशेष तरीके से कार्य करने की योग्यता या क्षमता; दूसरों पर नियंत्रण या प्रभाव डालना)
 
• **Authority**: The right or power to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience; the right to control or command. (आदेश देने, निर्णय लेने और आज्ञाकारिता लागू करने का अधिकार या शक्ति; नियंत्रण या आदेश देने का अधिकार)
